verdict.rationale: The evidence describes an npm-installed CLI workflow (`npm install -g @angular/cli`, `ng new`, `ng build`) and never documents loading Angular through a script tag without a package manager or bundler. The in-browser tutorial and the note about playing with Angular in the browser are hosted sandbox experiences, not script-tag usage of the framework, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the framework directly via a script tag without needing a package manager or bundler
